steps.content: You are escorted by guards through the confined corridor under the glaring lights and alarms. A huge guarded area appears before your eyes.

steps.speaker: Warning System
steps.content: Level 1 alert! Level 1 alert! Sinners escaped! Sinners escaped! Alert!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is <color=#fb9259>Minos Bureau of Crisis Control</color>, the jail for the most vicious criminals.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Every criminal here is a great threat to the world, and you, Chief, are supposed to be the strongest force to restrain them.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But now, an intruder has sparked off a riot. The prisoners are completely out of control. The first thing these rioters will do is...
The tempered glass in front of you suddenly exploded. Nightingale immediately protected you behind her and blocked the few people who bursted out.

steps.speaker: Rioter
steps.content: Don't tell me that guy behind you is the new...Heh, look at his dumb face. I bet he's still just a loser.
steps.female_content: Don't tell me that one behind you is the new...Heh, look at her dumb face. I bet she's still just a loser.

steps.speaker: Rioter
steps.content: I didn't expect to be free again. I planned to just run away, but since you guys have taken such good care of me, how could I not repay you?

steps.speaker: Rioter
steps.content: Kill him! We can only be truly free if that man is dead!
steps.female_content: Kill her! We can only be truly free if that woman is dead!
